title: Bluesky expands Attie into a research tool for open social conversations
friendlyTitle: Bluesky’s Attie can now help research public online conversations
summary: Bluesky’s Attie assistant can now answer questions about news, trends and conversations across Bluesky and other services built on the AT Protocol. The expansion turns a feed-building assistant into a broader research interface for open social data.
friendlySummary: Attie can answer questions about trends and discussions on Bluesky and other apps that use the open AT Protocol.
whyItMatters: Researchers, journalists and marketers gain another way to study public conversation without relying entirely on a closed social network. AI summaries can omit context or amplify noisy posts, so important findings should be checked against the underlying sources.
friendlyWhyItMatters: It may help people understand public conversations more quickly. Always open the original posts before trusting an important conclusion.
